rows.en: Wonder if you've heard of it, \p...
A little outfit called the New U.N. Forces?

(I never imagined Yuuto and the others
were part of the New U.N. Forces...)

(The three of them went to intercept those
unidentified creatures... Oh, looks like
they're back.)
Gary-sensei!?

Come to think of it, I never told you
I'm with the New U.N. Forces, did I?
And while I'm at it, Hilda's with 'em too.
rows.notes: Gary, both genders. Bare 'Hilda' as in the Japanese.

rows.en: (So that's how it was... I had no idea......)

So...
The other day, you said you wanted to enlist
in the New U.N. Forces, right?

So I figured I'd bring you here sooner or later...
but even I didn't think I'd end up bringing
you in a situation like this.
And things aren't the same now as they were...

\p...
Go think it over one more time, and think hard:
do you still want to join the New U.N. Forces?

It's hard to believe the fight with those
unidentified creatures is over after that.

Once you join the military now,
quitting is pretty much impossible.

In a fight against things with that much
power, are you ready to put your life
on the line?

You don't have to answer right away.
I'll give you some time, so make up your mind
and come back.
rows.notes: Gary in scd_arm, Ozma in scd_sms; both genders.

rows.en:
Y-yes...
Understood... Gary-sensei.

(I thought I'd made up my mind back when
I decided to enlist in the New U.N. Forces...)

(But now that I can see the danger with my
own eyes, there's no denying I'm a lot more
worried about enlisting...)

(I can't get in with a half-hearted attitude...
I've gotta make up my mind for real...!)
rows.notes: Male. Close to the S.M.S. twin c23950.

rows.en:
(I'm finally going to meet Sheryl Nome,
the "Galactic Fairy"...)

(All right! I'm giving today's EX-Gear
acrobatics everything I've got!!)

(Saotome-kun went off grandstanding and
nearly got Sheryl seriously hurt...)

(I need to get to a shelter too...
Wait, where did Kagura-kun and the others go?)

Kagura-kun, Miyuki, Yui! Where do you
think you're going in an emergency like this!?
rows.notes: Female. Female player uses Kagura-kun, Miyuki, Yui.

rows.en:
No part-time job would call you in during
an emergency like this! Come on, we need to
get to a shelter too......

\p-san,
would you come with us to our part-time job
right now?

(I never imagined Kagura-kun and the others
were part of the New U.N. Forces...)

(The three of them went to intercept those
unidentified creatures... Oh, looks like
they're back.)
(So that's how it was... I had no idea......)

(I thought I'd made up my mind back when
I decided to enlist in the New U.N. Forces...)

(I can't get in with a half-hearted attitude...
I've gotta make up my mind for real...!)

(Am I really ready to join the New U.N. Forces
and put my life on the line in battle...?)

(Of course fighting is scary...
I'm scared out of my mind, but......)

(But just standing by and watching while
Frontier gets attacked like last time?
No way. Absolutely not!)

(If fighting is the only way to protect
Frontier... then I......!)
Looks like you've made up your mind.

Please... Please let me join the
New U.N. Forces!
...You know there's no turning back, right?
I'm ready for that!

Sheesh... Report to the barracks
by 0800 tomorrow morning.
Understood, Gary-sensei.
Heh. Starting tomorrow, it's Captain Gary.
rows.notes: Gary, both genders. Taii = Captain (ranks), as ext_oth_003.

rows.en:
Starting tomorrow, you're training with me!
Let's give it our all, \p!
Go easy on me, okay, Yuuto?

(Starting tomorrow, I'm a member of the
New U.N. Forces too... I'm going to fight
to protect Frontier!)

(Am I really ready to join the New U.N. Forces
and put my life on the line in battle...?)

(But just standing by and watching while
Frontier gets attacked like last time?
No way. Absolutely not!)

(If fighting is the only way to protect
Frontier... then I......!)

Please... Please let me join the
New U.N. Forces!
Go easy on me, okay, Kagura-kun?

(Starting tomorrow, I'm a member of the
New U.N. Forces too... I'll fight to protect
Frontier as well!)

(It's my day off today, so I think I'll
go wander around downtown Frontier.)
(Hm? My phone's ringing.)
Hello, this is \p.

This is Gary.
We're holding your final enlistment test,
starting now.
rows.notes: Gary, both genders. As Ozma's twin c23977.

rows.en: What!? This is so sudden...

It's an emergency call-up. You don't get to refuse.
Get to the New U.N. Forces hangar, on the double.
(So the final test was a surprise one...)
Well? Where's your answer!
rows.notes: Gary in scd_arm, Ozma in scd_sms; both genders.

rows.en: R-roger that!

(Getting hit with the final test out of
nowhere... I'm not ready for this yet.
I'm starting to get kinda nervous...)

Oh, come on, don't get so tense.
If you just do what you always do,
you'll be fine, no doubt about it.

Yeah... You're right!
Thank you, Claire-senpai!
rows.notes: PLAYER, both genders. Answers before noticing who it is.

rows.en: All riiight! Let's do this!
...Wait, Claire-senpai!?

Hehe, what are you so surprised about,
\p-kun?

Of course I'm surprised!
Who knew you were in the New U.N. Forces,
Claire-senpai...

If you're that surprised, keeping it secret
was worth it. The truth is, I've been
serving as an operator.
So that's how it was.

I'll be giving the orders during combat,
so you'd better listen to what I say,
got it?

Good answer.
Now go give that test your all.
(Okay! I'm going to pass this, no matter what!)
rows.notes: Male. Matches the female twin c20791 (slice 290).

rows.en: (Hm? My phone's ringing.)
(So the final test was a surprise one...)

(Getting hit with the final test out of
nowhere... I'm not ready for this yet.
I'm starting to get kinda nervous...)
All riiight! Let's do this!

Hehe, what are you so surprised about,
\p-chan?

uncertain: c20765: 'Frontier shigai' rendered 'downtown Frontier'; no glossary entry for the city area.
c20747 / c20760: the Japanese is one exclamation ('just watching while Frontier is attacked like before is absolutely unacceptable'); rendered as a question plus refusal across 3 lines.
